stress_maximum.description: Size of the Stress gauge. Valid: 10–1000.

stress_high_threshold.description: Stress at which High Stress warnings start; when not set, three quarters of stress_maximum. Valid: 1–1000, at most stress_maximum.

stress_degradation_probability.description: Chance a tap slips onto a neighbouring tile at Maximum Stress. Valid: 0–1.

stress_accumulation_percent_per_second.description: Stress added per second of play, as a percentage of the gauge, in every week. Valid: 0–20.

coffee_recovery_base.description: Stress removed by a Coffee triple in Week 1. Valid: 0–1000.

coffee_recovery_decline_per_week.description: How much less a Coffee triple removes each later week. Valid: 0–100.

music_recovery.description: Stress removed by a Music triple. Valid: 0–1000.

music_slowdown_multiplier.description: Stress speed while the Music effect lasts (0.5 = half speed). Valid: 0–1.

music_slowdown_millis.description: How long the Music slowdown lasts, in milliseconds. Valid: 0–60000.

shake_threshold_g.description: Linear acceleration (in g, gravity removed) a shake must reach. Valid: 0.5–5.

shake_required_hits.description: Consecutive strong readings needed for a shake. Valid: 1–10.

shake_cooldown_millis.description: Minimum time between shuffles, in milliseconds. Valid: 0–10000.

shake_smoothing.description: Shake filter smoothing (1 = no smoothing). Valid: 0.01–1.

tilt_deadzone_degrees.description: Tilt below this angle does nothing. Valid: 0–45.

tilt_full_peek_degrees.description: Tilt angle for a full peek. Valid: 1–90, above the deadzone.

tilt_smoothing.description: Tilt filter smoothing (1 = no smoothing). Valid: 0.01–1.

tilt_release_hysteresis_degrees.description: How far below the deadzone the peek releases, to avoid flicker. Valid: 0–45, at most the deadzone.
